source.credit: AGFA-GEVAERT AG; original manufacturer measurements and graph content

apx100-density.conditions: Panel captioned 'Dichtekurve; Density curve' with no developer, time or densitometry stated. See film.development_note for what the sheet does let us conclude.

apx100-sensitivity.conditions: Panel captioned 'Spektrale Empfindlichkeit; Spectral sensitivity'. No density criterion, exposure time or processing is stated, unlike Kodak's sheets. Relative shape only.

film.name: Agfapan APX 100 (experimental)
film.development_note: The sheet does not label the density curve with a developer or time, and its gradient does not match recommended development. Measured average gradient is 0.567 over 1.3 decades and 0.598 over 1.5, from the point 0.1 above base. The sheet's own gamma-time curves read about 0.650 at every recommended 20 C time (Refinal 6, Rodinal 1+25 8, Rodinal 1+50 17, Rodinal Special 4, Studional 4). Reading those curves back at 0.598 gives 3.4, 4.4, 6.1 and 14.4 minutes - consistently about 0.8 of the recommended time on all four. So the panel shows less than recommended development; the exact conditions are not stated and cannot be recovered. 6 minutes is recorded as a nominal label only.
film.base_density_note: Estimated asymptote just below the lowest plotted total density. The plotted left plateau averages 0.3032 and the lowest plotted point is 0.3024.
film.ceiling_note: Not measured. The plot stops at total density 2.36 at log exposure 2.0, still rising. 3.5 matches the ceiling assumed for the existing B&W preparations; the source does not measure this shoulder.
film.exposure_origin_note: Rendering convention: shift source exposure so net density 0.75 occurs at engine log exposure zero, matching the Double-X and Tri-X anchor. Not absolute ISO metering.
film.sensitivity_note: PCHIP of the single plotted log-sensitivity trace; engine covers 380-780 nm. The trace spans 380.42-662.45 nm and meets the panel's floor at 662.0 nm, so it is truncated at 660 nm; 380 nm is left unmeasured because the trace begins above it. Both are explicit unmeasured-tail approximations, not proof of zero sensitivity.
film.density_tolerance_note: Set from the printed line, not borrowed: the density curve is stroked at 0.997 pt, which is 0.0284 D on this panel's scale, against 0.0156 D for the Kodak sheet behind the Tri-X preparation. 0.018 keeps the same fraction of the stroke width that preparation's 0.01 gate did. This is a graph-fitting tolerance, not an empirical accuracy claim.

print.note: Paired with the existing B&W paper preparation. Agfa published no paper pairing for this film; this is a rendering choice, not a manufacturer recommendation.

sampling.method: Constrained positive normal-CDF mixture, four mathematical components, fitting source points plus a 0.3-weight PCHIP/continuation prior. Shares scripts/bw_expansion/prepare.py's fit; components are mathematical, not measured emulsion layers.
